Question 8

Maria has a bank account at LJB Bank. She has an overdraft facility authorized by this bank. Her bank balance on Monday was −$40.00. To reduce her debt, Maria decides to make a deposit of $18.60 into her bank account on the following Tuesday. What is Maria's balance at the end of the day on Tuesday?

a
 −$18.60
b
 −$23.10
c
 −$17.50
d
 −$20.90
e
 −$21.40
